title: iQOO Z11 to launch in India with a different processor, 3D curved display
description: iQOO introduced the Z11 Lite in India last week, and now a Gadgets360 report claims the company will launch the Z11 in the country in August. The publication also claims that the iQOO Z11 will launch in India with the Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, making it the first smartphone in the Asian country to have that chip under the hood. The Z11 launched in China is powered by the Dimensity 8500 SoC, while Malaysia got the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4. title: Apple releases iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6 with tons of security fixes
description: Today Apple has released iOS 26.6 and iPadOS 26.6. Both of these come with a whopping 78 security fixes, so it's definitely recommended that you install them as soon as possible. In case you haven't already been notified about the update, you can go to Settings > General > Software Update to manually check for it. It should then be downloaded and installed. description: Google already lets you unlock your phone using a Pixel Watch through the Watch Unlock feature, but now it seems like the company is working on letting you do it the other way around as well. Strings of code found in the latest Connected Phone & Watch app show a "Phone to Watch Unlock" feature. When it launches, this will automatically unlock your Pixel Watch when your paired Pixel phone is unlocked. Unfortunately, this is very likely exclusive to a Pixel phone and Pixel watch pairing. description: Last week a report surfaced claiming that Nothing would be exiting "12 or more" global markets, following in the footsteps of OnePlus, the previous brand Nothing co-founder Carl Pei co-founded. He says the company is reorganizing its teams to prepare for its next phase of growth, introducing dedicated business units and "consolidating individual countries into regional hubs to operate much more efficiently". description: Following its US exclusive launch last week, Apple is expanding its Apple Care One plan to four new markets. Starting from August 4, Apple users in the UK, France, Germany and Australia will be eligible for the new device protection bundle. Apple Care One is Cupertino’s all-in-one protection plan, which features all of the benefits from Apple Care+ like unlimited repairs, theft and loss coverage and 24/7 priority support from Apple experts, but covers more devices under a single subscription.
